title: Discovery team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/discovery.yaml, the team layer of the discovery plugin's settings. A key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Keys and resolution: plugins/discovery/reference/config.md.

written_against.description: The plugin version the setup writer last wrote this file against, as <plugin>@<version>. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

provenance.description: Per setting, whether the team chose the value or it was filled at the plugin default. The writer owns it; it is not a setting.

explore_output.description: What /discovery:explore replies with after it writes EXPLORE.md. auto: explain for a person asking how something works, change-prep otherwise. change-prep: the handoff summary for the next stage. explain: a walkthrough with file:line citations.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (skip the verifier dispatch), standard (today's behavior) or strict (run the passes that are optional today). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example research); an entry beats this file's verification value.
